# LBH

> LBH is an Israeli investment group founded by Shimon Ben Hamo and Ofer Linchevski. It manages three investment funds - Dan, Gadot and Mankai - combining senior executive experience, investment expertise and hands-on value creation (Buy & Build).

The authoritative information is the visible content of the pages below.
